tara (People Ops): cheat-sheet: 8-question self-review template for fast calibration. paste into the self-review form or share in your kickoff thread.

tara (People Ops): keep answers one line where possible. examples included.

tara (People Ops): 1) Objective I worked on (one sentence):
2) My top measurable outcome + evidence (link/number):
3) One risk that slowed progress + mitigation I tried: 
4) One thing I learned that changes how we run this work: 
5) Peer contributions I relied on (names + what): 
6) What I would do differently next cycle: 
7) One upward feedback item for my manager (specific ask): 
8) Quick rating: on-track / needs-support / blocked

omar (eng-manager): love the concision. can we add a line for "impact on customer"? helps product and support calibrate.

tara (People Ops): added a micro-prompt you can paste after Q2: "Customer signal (quote or metric):"

yana (product): also suggest an optional 1-sentence context box for distributed teams: "Context: cross-team dependencies or rollout windows"

ivy (ic): for KRs where Im not owner, is it ok to write contributions in the same template?

tara (People Ops): yes. suggested phrasing: "Contributed by owning X (code review, doc, infra) - artifact link." keeps reviewers from guessing.

ops-bot: :pushpin: Saved template to People Ops snippets and linked it in the handbook under Performance > Self-review.

omar (eng-manager): I'll drop this into my next calibration packet. thanks."
